CEAST 9050 Tester from Instron 
View Supplier Profile
Request Quote 
This video shows an overview of CEAST 9050 tester from Instron. The CEAST 9050 impact pendulum is designed for determining the resilience of thermoplastic materials to impact. Tests conform to internationally recognized standards belonging to Charpy, Izod, and Pipe and Tensile Impact methods. Plastics, composites and metals can be tested using various configurations of the 9050 pendulum.
